document_title: Process Characterization Plan — Anion Exchange Chromatography (Step 8)
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
out_of_schema_notes: AEX sets one CQA (cumulative MVM clearance); the other QualityAttribute entities are the CQAs it controls/clears (formed/introduced upstream). The plan renders all five in one table.
Flow-through-pool HCP and step-LRF are in-process/modular responses; captured via StudyDesign.responses.
The Plan states classification is an OUTPUT; parameter_type left 'unclassified' here.

Every entity and assertion is anchored on its own rendered table row where the document renders one (parameters, CQAs, methods, risk-assessment scope, acceptance criteria); prose anchors are used only for relations no table carries.

process_steps.description: Flow-through anion-exchange polishing: the final chromatographic step of the process. Sets the cumulative MVM (parvovirus) viral-clearance claim and is a major clearance step for enveloped virus (XMuLV), HCP, residual DNA and leached Protein A. The product transmits while impurities and virus bind.

source_references.quote: Anion exchange chromatography is the final chromatographic step of the A-Mab drug substance process, and it is operated in the flow-through mode
The anion exchange step is a flow-through polish.
The principal risk to this study is that the scale-down model does not represent the commercial column
Every run in this study will be performed on a qualified scale-down model of the commercial column
Cambridge, MA (Development)
Grafton, WI (Commercial DS)

statements.statement_text: PCP-008 defines the process characterization study for the A-Mab anion-exchange polishing step (Step 8), and it states no findings.

source_references.quote: This plan defines the process characterization study for that step

statements.statement_text: Five process parameters will be characterized; four are studied in the multivariate designs and the operating flow rate univariately.

source_references.quote: The parameters, their set-points, the ranges to be studied and the normal operating ranges are given in

statements.statement_text: The multivariate work is a two-level full-factorial screen followed by a face-centred central-composite design in the same four factors.

source_references.quote: The response-surface study is a face-centred central composite design in the same 4 factors

statements.statement_text: The cumulative MVM clearance claim is assigned to this step, and the claim rests on anion exchange and small-virus retentive filtration together, because a parvovirus is not inactivated by the low-pH hold.

source_references.quote: MVM is a non-enveloped parvovirus, so it is not inactivated by the low-pH hold at Step 6, and the claim rests on the anion exchange step and the small virus retentive filter together.

statements.statement_text: No parameter of the step is left unstudied, so the study scope is the whole parameter set of the unit operation.

source_references.quote: No parameter of this step was left unstudied, so the study scope is the whole parameter set of the unit operation and not a filtered subset of it.

statements.statement_text: The operating region will be declared acceptable only when the fitted response-surface models predict every governed attribute inside its criterion across the whole region.

source_references.quote: The operating region will be declared acceptable when the fitted response-surface models predict every governed attribute inside its criterion across the whole region

statements.statement_text: The plan sets no numerical capability threshold; the report will argue each Cpk from the margin to the limit and the criticality of the attribute.

source_references.quote: This plan sets no numerical capability threshold.
